outcome: Prenatal diagnosis of Fetal Skeletal Dysplasia (FSD)
cohort: Nineteen fetuses suspected of having skeletal dysplasia based on ultrasound examination were included.
finding: 3D-CT is a valuable tool for augmenting ultrasound examinations in the diagnosis and classification of FSD, with 16 out of 17 (94.1%) prenatally diagnosed FSD cases confirmed postnatally.
followup_time: Postnatal confirmation for all cases, and up to the neonatal period for those who survived.
